deliverables: Secondary marketplace for listing, pricing, and reselling tickets with on-chain settlement
Smart-contract royalty enforcement for artists and venues
Custodial wallet onboarding inside Sellout's existing flow
Organizer dashboard and ticket lifecycle tools
Independent third-party smart-contract security audit with published report and remediation
Public launch campaign and three trade-show activations
Public metrics dashboard and governance reporting
request.what: Fund Phase 2 of a production Cardano-native ticketing platform operated by Sellout.io and built by Anvil Development Agency, including a secondary marketplace, royalty enforcement, anti-scalping controls, wallet onboarding, organizer tools, security audit, and launch campaign.

claims.claim: Phase 1 of the Sellout ticketing platform is already live on Cardano mainnet and was funded entirely by Sellout with over $130,000 invested.
The proposal requests 4,969,231 ada, approximately $1,093,231 at $0.22 per ADA, over 8 months with milestone-gated disbursement.
Phase 2 will deliver a secondary marketplace, royalty enforcement, anti-scalping controls, wallet onboarding, organizer tools, an independent audit, and launch amplification.
Sellout has 200,000+ registered users, has issued 250,000+ tickets to date, and currently supports 350+ events annually.
The Yellowstone Club 2026 concert series is a contracted anchor deployment projected to move over $6 million through Cardano in year one.
The team commits to repay $1,093,231 to the Cardano Treasury through a revenue-share mechanism using 25% of all fees until full reimbursement and 5% thereafter.
The proposal states that all on-chain metrics will be independently verifiable through Cardano explorer data and policy-ID tracking, with a public metrics dashboard going live in M5.
The requested amount does not breach the applicable 350M Net Change Limit covering Epoch 613 to Epoch 713 at the moment of submission.
Intersect would administer the funds through the Sundae Labs TRSC/PSSC framework with independent oversight and public on-chain auditability.
Anvil and Sellout have not received ada from the Cardano Treasury within the last 24 months.

summary: The document requests 4,969,231 ada for an 8-month Phase 2 buildout of a Cardano-native ticketing platform, asserting existing mainnet work, substantial Sellout adoption, a Yellowstone Club anchor deployment, milestone-gated administration through Intersect/TRSC/PSSC, and a contractual revenue-share repayment commitment, but many commercial adoption, NCL, and prior-funding assertions are proposer-stated rather than evidenced in the anchor text.
